UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile information within the AutoDev Pod application, linked to an external authentication system. This entity stores application-specific user data, not authentication credentials.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

externalUserId.description: Unique identifier for the user from the external authentication system. (Relationship: ExternalAuthSystem 1:1 UserProfile)

username.description: Display name chosen by the user within the application.

email.description: Email address of the user, potentially retrieved from the external authentication system.

preferredTheme.description: User's preferred UI theme setting for the application (e.g., 'dark', 'light').

avatarUrl.description: URL to the user's profile avatar image.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was initially created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. The `userId` in the path corresponds to `request.auth.uid` (and `externalUserId` in the document), making it privately owned by the authenticated user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user, matching `request.auth.uid`.

definition.description: Represents an AI-powered development pod owned by a specific user. Includes `ownerId` (matching `userId` from the path) and a `status` field for explicit state modeling. This path ensures projects are scoped to the authenticated user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this project, matching `request.auth.uid`.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier for the project.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed with a strong emphasis on Authorization Independence and Query Accessibility Patterns (QAPs) to ensure security, scalability, and debuggability.
